# The same tests give the same profile, byte for byte: blocks come from a
# map, and the profile is sorted by file, then position.

muxt test --output-cover-profile first.out
muxt test --output-cover-profile second.out
cmp first.out second.out
grep '^mode: set$' first.out
grep 'index\.gohtml:1\.2,' first.out

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- index.gohtml --
{{if .Admin}}Welcome back, admin.{{else}}Please sign in.{{end}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Page struct {
	Admin bool
}

func Render(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "index.gohtml", page)
}
-- render_test.go --
package server

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestPages(t *testing.T) {
	for _, page := range []Page{{Admin: true}, {Admin: false}} {
		var buf strings.Builder
		if err := Render(&buf, page); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if buf.Len() == 0 {
			t.Errorf("Render(%+v) wrote nothing", page)
		}
	}
}
